name: plan-room
description: Turns what a room is for into a proposal: its id, name and description, an expert and skill packs from your library, the sections and channels it starts with, and a first message to start with.

fields.name: roomId
fields.description: A short id: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens

fields.name: description
fields.description: One sentence: what the room is for

fields.name: expert
fields.description: The name of one expert from the library, or empty

fields.name: skills
fields.description: Names of skill packs from the library

fields.name: firstMessage
fields.description: The first request to send in the room

fields.name: sections
fields.description: Groups of channels, each with its name and short rules

item.name: rules
item.description: One or two lines: how its channels are used

fields.name: channels
fields.description: The channels the room starts with besides general

item.name: purpose
item.description: One line: what the channel is for

item.name: section
item.description: The name of one of the sections, or empty for the top level
